newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peregrine signs Euro CP program.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine signs Euro CP program.

text.p: Peregrine Investment Holdings Ltd said its US$100 million multicurrency Euro-Commercial Paper Program was signed on Thursday.
The program is supported by a Direct Pay Letter of Credit and Back-up Liquidity Facility, Peregrine said in a statement.
Under the program, the issuer can issue Euro-commercial paper denominated in U.S. dollars, yen, sterling and Deutsche marks with a maximum maturity of 364 days.
The letter of credit is issued by the Industrial Bank of Korea.
The program is expected to obtain an A-1 rating from Standard and Poor's and P-1 from Moody's, Peregrine said.
Korea Long Term Credit Bank is the arranger.
Lead managers are Industrial Bank of Korea, Pusan Bank and Seoul Bank.
Managers are Kangwon Bank and Kyongnam Bank.
Goldman Sachs International, Daiwa Europe and Peregrine Fixed Income are dealers of the program.
